message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk," Li Hua proposed several design elements for Yuriko's studio homepage. Specifically, Li Hua suggested incorporating a user feedback section, which would include a simple form for users to leave comments or suggestions, along with a star rating system. Additionally, Li Hua recommended adding space for testimonials, as these can help build trust among potential clients. These suggestions were aimed at enhancing the functionality and user experience of the homepage. The overall theme for the design was to match the overall aesthetic of the studio, suggesting soft and calming pastel colors to create a welcoming atmosphere.
